label: Single Pleat
description: A single pleat at the cuff is one small fold of fabric set where the sleeve gathers into the cuff, easing the fuller sleeve into the narrower cuff opening. This single tuck creates a tidy, minimal gather and a clean transition at the wrist. It is the more understated of the cuff-pleat options, keeping the sleeve neat without excess bulk.
